haiku.problem: The question says 'ask Moses to do' and the right answer begins 'Ask the LORD,' so the answer's verb is echoed in the question and stands out from the wrong answers.

The set leaves out the central point of the passage, that anyone bitten who looks at the bronze snake will live (cards 1-15 and 1-16). This true/false instead tests a weaker, negated claim about only the first person.
